title: Igrot Kodesh - Letter No. 191
response_propositions: The letter treats unpaid balances to Kehot as a direct constraint on further publishing projects and requests practical settlement of amounts owed.
In its spiritual reading of mikveh immersion, complete submersion represents a self-nullification that must encompass intellect, emotion and conduct rather than remain partial.
The proposed remedy combines acceptance of the Divine yoke with coordinated emotional capacities, so that meditation produces changed behavior.
proposition_source_locator: publisher translation, lines 278-321: reply sections e-f and the mikveh-mishnah exposition
verification_scope: The authorized publisher's English translation was inspected. Propositions paraphrase only the visible outgoing letter; the incoming correspondence, physical original and original-language witness were not inspected.
documented_circumstances: Letter No. 191 to R. Chanoch Hendel Havlin, dated 21 Menachem Av 5705, responding to several letters and combining administrative requests with a Torah exposition.
